beats: Hook: X flips 0 and 1 but leaves |+> as it is; Z leaves 0 and 1 alone but swaps + and -. Which single gate turns one into the other? (line_qc_hbridge_two_glasses: one qubit, two pairs of glasses, the Z basis and the X basis.) Same cast as QC05-01: the tinkerer and the skeptic.

X, the quantum NOT: it swaps |0> and |1> (reuse line_switch_dimmer, the toggle half) and keeps |+> (|-> only gains a sign) (Q25-05 13:29-18:34, clip 17:42-18:09). The states a gate leaves pointing the same way (its eigenvectors) are its axis, like the centre of a spinning roundabout (line_qc_hbridge_roundabout).
Z: leaves |0> and |1> alone and acts as a NOT on |+> and |-> (19:25-24:53). X and Z are two lenses on the same qubit (24:12-24:37; line_qc_hbridge_two_glasses again).
H = (X + Z)/sqrt2 is the bridge between the lenses: 0 -> +, 1 -> -, + -> 0, - -> 1, and crossing twice brings you back, H^2 = I (24:57-28:11, clip 26:47-27:12; line_qc_hbridge_footbridge).

Z = HXH and X = HZH: change basis, act, change back, like piping icing on the back of a cake: turn the stand, pipe at the front, turn it back (Q24-04 24:56-32:36, clip 30:50-31:45; line_qc_hbridge_cake_turntable).

Is it a coincidence that the sum of X and Z swaps their bases? A teaser for the "grand unification of quantum algorithms" (Martyn, Rossi, Tan, Chuang, PRX Quantum 2021) (Q25-05 28:39-31:06; Q24-04 33:17-34:43; taped slide, no drawing).

Global vs relative phase: a minus sign on the whole state changes nothing you can measure; a minus sign on one branch is real, because branches interfere, like ripples from two dippers whose overlap pattern shifts when one dipper is moved out of step (Q24-04 13:25-15:21, clip 14:24-15:21; 19:18-22:00; line_qc_hbridge_ripple_tank).

The light version of the same point: the whole band one beat late sounds the same song; only the drummer late sounds wrong (line_qc_hbridge_duet_offbeat). Caption it as a picture of "only the relative part matters", not as phase being timing.
Cover (line_cover_qc05_02; for the X post and thumbnails, not a film beat): the skeptic on a small arched footbridge swaps round glasses for square ones; the tinkerer waves from the bank.
